- Descriptive; not prespecified in the SAP.

```{r}
#| label: setup

library(here)
library(arrow)
library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)

results_dir <- here("analysis", "10-implementation", "results")
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Follow-up from consent

```{r}
#| label: accepted-patients

cohort <- read_parquet(
  here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet")
)

accepted <- cohort |>
  filter(invitation_accepted == 1L) |>
  mutate(
    # Missing vital status gives a missing endpoint date, not a censored one.
    endpoint_date = if_else(
      status_death_unrestricted == 1L,
      death_date,
      last_known_alive_date
    ),
    # enrolled_date is the consent date in the export.
    follow_up_days_from_consent = as.numeric(
      endpoint_date - as.Date(enrolled_date)
    ),
    has_eight_weeks = !is.na(follow_up_days_from_consent) &
      follow_up_days_from_consent >= 56
  )

if (nrow(accepted) == 0L) stop("No patients accepted the invitation.")

# Accepters with known follow-up shorter than eight weeks, and with none.
short_follow_up <- accepted |>
  filter(!has_eight_weeks, !is.na(follow_up_days_from_consent))

died_before_eight_weeks <- sum(short_follow_up$status_death_unrestricted == 1L)
censored_before_eight_weeks <- sum(
  short_follow_up$status_death_unrestricted == 0L
)
follow_up_date_missing <- sum(is.na(accepted$follow_up_days_from_consent))
```

## MTB outcomes

```{r}
#| label: mtb-outcomes

mtb_summary <- bind_rows(
  "All invitation accepters" = accepted,
  "At least 8 weeks from consent" = filter(accepted, has_eight_weeks),
  .id = "population"
) |>
  summarise(
    patients = n(),
    registered = sum(mtb_reg == 1L, na.rm = TRUE),
    registered_percent = 100 * registered / patients,
    discussed = sum(n_mtb >= 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    discussed_percent = 100 * discussed / patients,
    recommendation_report_sent = sum(mtb_n_reports >= 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    recommendation_report_sent_percent =
      100 * recommendation_report_sent / patients,
    missing_registration = sum(is.na(mtb_reg)),
    missing_discussion = sum(is.na(n_mtb)),
    missing_recommendation_report = sum(is.na(mtb_n_reports)),
    .by = population
  ) |>
  mutate(
    died_before_eight_weeks = died_before_eight_weeks,
    censored_before_eight_weeks = censored_before_eight_weeks,
    follow_up_date_missing = follow_up_date_missing
  )

distribution <- accepted |>
  count(n_mtb, name = "patients")

write_parquet(
  mtb_summary,
  file.path(results_dir, "mtb-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
write_parquet(
  distribution,
  file.path(results_dir, "mtb-discussion-distribution.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: mtb-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Molecular tumour board outcomes"
#| echo: false

mtb_summary |>
  select(
    population,
    patients,
    registered,
    registered_percent,
    discussed,
    discussed_percent,
    recommendation_report_sent,
    recommendation_report_sent_percent,
    missing_registration,
    missing_discussion,
    missing_recommendation_report
  ) |>
  kable()
```
